scope: Bounded read-only form metadata extraction connected to synthetic mock questionnaire preflight.

environment.browser: Local Playwright Chromium with in-memory synthetic HTML

checks.target: bounded metadata parser, synthetic mock preflight integration, durable audit readback, and mock browser regression suite
checks.details: Includes all allowed metadata inputs, combined metadata, malformed/ambiguous controls and bounds, sensitive/credential classification, no value capture or DOM interaction, analyzer-specific rejection of malformed optional metadata while legal preflight is asserted PASS, zero attempts/receipts, and durable audit readback.

checks.target: changed analyzer, mock integration, and tests

checks.command: Red-first unit and integration tests before implementation
checks.details: Initial unit run failed because form_analysis.py was absent; initial integration run showed missing audit metadata and a sensitive question passing preflight. On the rebased source, the new sibling span/output regression failed because rendered text was included; the analyzer-specific optional-control preflight regression passed before the privacy fix.

acceptance.metadata_sources: PASS for bounded label, name, id, placeholder, ARIA label, input type, section heading, fieldset legend, dropdown option labels, and structured mock nearby text. The browser DOM analyzer omits arbitrary nearby sibling text because it cannot reliably distinguish static help from rendered answers.
acceptance.read_only_behavior: PASS; extractor only queries DOM metadata; synthetic browser test observed zero click, input, change, or submit events.
acceptance.privacy: PASS; current values, option values, password values, cookies, and credentials are never returned. Dynamic span/output text inside labels, headings, or legends is omitted and marks analysis UNKNOWN.
acceptance.mock_preflight_connection: PASS; a malformed optional control leaves legal preflight otherwise PASS, while analyzer UNKNOWN blocks browser startup and yields REVIEW_REQUIRED with zero attempts and receipts; audit readback remains durable.
acceptance.scope: PARTIAL; live DOM nearby text is intentionally unavailable to preserve the no-current-answer guarantee; the deterministic extractor and mock integration remain limited to metadata analysis.

limitations.whole_requirement: PARTIAL; this slice does not implement general form filling, OCR, taxonomy mapping, or broader application automation.

safety.external_requests: NONE; local fixture server and in-memory synthetic DOM only.
